request.query: bombas.com company profile: industry, number of employees, countries it sells to, website languages, how its team works (remote, hybrid, or office), and whether it is hiring
request.systemPrompt: Research the company that owns the website bombas.com. Prefer the company's own site (about, careers, help, store) and reputable business sources. Report facts only. If a fact cannot be determined, use "unknown" for strings, 0 for numbers, false for booleans, and an empty list for arrays. Never guess.
additionalQueries: bombas.com careers: open roles, remote or hybrid or in-office work, office locations
bombas.com about us: company size, headquarters, and countries or markets served
bombas.com online store e-commerce platform and tech stack

highlights.query: company size, markets served, remote or office work, open roles, online store platform

employee_count.description: Approximate total number of employees; 0 if unknown

sells_to.description: Who the company primarily sells to

online_store_platform.description: E-commerce platform behind its online store (e.g. 'Shopify'); 'none' if it does not sell online; 'unknown' if it cannot be determined

countries_served.description: Countries or regions it sells or ships to, one per item. If it serves many, list its largest markets, or a count such as '150+ countries'

website_languages.description: Languages its website, store, or help pages are offered in

work_model.description: How most employees work, from its careers pages and job posts: remote-first, hybrid, or in an office

actively_hiring.description: Whether its careers page or job boards list open roles right now

handles_sensitive_data.description: Whether the company's core product involves customers' health or financial records (health tracking, banking, insurance, lending). Taking card payments at checkout does not count

properties.name: Bombas
properties.description: Bombas is a comfort focused apparel brand with a mission to help those in need. The organization launched in 2013, after the founders learned that socks are the #1 most requested clothing item at homeless shelters. From there, they set out to solve that problem, donating a pair of socks for every pair they sell. How do you donate a lot of socks? You sell a lot. And how do you sell a lot? You make the most comfortable socks in the history of feet. Millions of pairs sold and donated later, Bombas is continuing to innovate with new socks and apparel while creating a positive impact on the community where we all work and live.
